summary: IAMAuth (kind='iam') models AWS IAM authentication for Redshift, S3-backed catalogs. Supports explicit credentials (access_key_id, secret_access_key, session_token), role assumption (role_arn), and ambient credential chain (all fields None). Default dispatch in AUTH_TO_DRIVER_KWARGS.
lifecycle_notes: All fields optional — empty IAMAuth means 'use ambient AWS credentials (env vars, instance profile, SSO)'
